about: Hand-curated registry of the property keys the Forge bridge emits on tokens, action options and records. Each component of a token is encoded as (key embedding, value repr); the key embedding is the frozen text embedding of `description`. Counter keys are expanded from counter_keys.json (generated from Forge by scripts/gen_counter_keys.py). tests/test_keys.py fails when the bridge emits a key that is not here. Layout (schema 9): `identity` and `ref` keys sit at the top level of a token next to `type`, `zone` and `edges`; every other key (number/flag/string/string_list) is nested under the token's `components` object, which is omitted when empty, and flags appear only when true. magicnet.bridge.Schema.isTopLevel implements this split and tests/test_schema.py checks it against this file. The record envelope is not a token and stays flat. Schema 16: decision option tokens (type action) and the prompt token (type decision) use the token layout; a candidate that references an existing token is just {"ref": id}. A categorical key may override its vocab per token type with `type_vocabs` (verb on action tokens: action_verb). Schema 13: history tokens carry no refs; participants are edges (see magicnet.schema.RELATIONS) and closed-vocabulary components are `categorical` with a `vocab` named in magicnet.schema.VOCABS.

value_kinds.string: short string; embed the value with the catalog's text embedder (POST /strings/embed)
value_kinds.string_list: list of short strings; embed each and pool
value_kinds.categorical: value from a closed vocabulary named by the key's `vocab`; look up a learned embedding per vocabulary (shared across keys with the same vocab)
value_kinds.ref: names or points at another object/player; top-level (not under components); should become an edge
value_kinds.identity: join key / token identity, not a component; top-level; never encoded as (key, value)

keys.notes: Selects the encoder (schema.ENCODER_MAPPING); not a component. Schema 16: action = decision option token, decision = the record's prompt token.
Values are magicnet.schema.ZONES (index with schema.zone_index). Stays at the token top level: it is also structural (sides, masking, segment embedding).
Resolved to relation-aware attention bias, not a component.

Join key for edges; stripped by dump.strip_ids. On history tokens (schema 13): e<N>, the event's index in this viewer's history, which cause and affected_by edges point at. On hidden-region aggregates (schema 15): r:<zone> (r:opp_hand, r:opp_library, r:opp_sideboard), the join key of that region's hidden_truth label; face-down objects keep their card id. Schema 16: own-library name aggregates carry n:<name> (the join key decision candidates reference); option tokens a<i> (i = candidate index); the prompt token q.

Embedded even when oracle_id is present: names are part of the rules grammar ("cards named X", "with X in its name"). Absent on an object the viewer cannot see (schema 12; per the rules an unseen or face-down card has no name), including the hidden-sideboard/library count aggregates; such tokens carry no oracle_id either. Test with magicnet.dump.is_hidden. Stays at the token top level for redaction checks. Phantoms (schema 13) carry the last-known name; an ability phantom carries its source's name.
Join to the card catalog.
On history tokens: the turn the event happened in (0 = pregame).

keys.description: current phase and step of the turn
keys.notes: Forge PhaseType name (UNTAP ... CLEANUP), or NONE before the first turn (schema 13; was the string "null"). Values are magicnet.schema.PHASES.

keys.description: number of spells and abilities on the stack
whose player this is: me or my opponent
keys.notes: "self" or "opp". On a phantom (schema 13): whose object it was (controller). Schema 19, on a spell (game_object in zone stack) or an ability (stack_item) on the stack: whose spell/ability it is (controller / activating player) -- the stack is one shared zone, so the zone does not say.

keys.description: which face or state of the card is showing
keys.notes: Forge CardStateName, e.g. Original, Transformed, Flipped, FaceDown.

keys.description: summoning sick: came under my control this turn

keys.notes: On history (move events): the object was face down when it moved; public. Schema 19: also on a spell cast face down on the stack (morph, disguise); nameless unless the viewer controls it.

keys.description: is a token rather than a card
base power before pumps and counters
keys.notes: Schema 10. After copy effects and characteristic-defining/setting effects (layers 1, 7a-b); power minus base_power is the sum of modifiers.

keys.description: base toughness before pumps and counters
keys.notes: Schema 10. Same layers as base_power.
Layer-resolved, e.g. "Legendary Creature - Human Knight".
Lowercased color names, or ["colorless"].

keys.description: abilities this object has that are not printed on it
keys.notes: Schema 10. Engine-resolved difference from the printed card (oracle_id): keywords and triggered/activated/static/replacement abilities, incl. Forge hidden extrinsic keywords. Host-independent rules text ("Trample", "This creature can't block."), sorted, deduplicated.

keys.description: printed abilities this object no longer has
keys.notes: Schema 10. "Loses all abilities" lists every printed ability lost, one entry each. Same text normalization as gained.

keys.description: opponent's hidden card I know because it was revealed to me
opponent's card that is currently revealed
creature or card type chosen for this permanent
card name chosen for this permanent
keys.notes: Names a card that need not be on the board; join via named_card_oracle_id to the card catalog (an edge to a card-catalog node rather than a token).

keys.description: oracle id of the chosen card name

keys.notes: Player ref (p0/p1). Should become an edge to the player token.

keys.description: value of X paid when this was cast
keys.notes: On history (cast/copy_spell): X announced for the spell. Schema 19: also on a spell on the stack (game_object in zone stack).
On history (cast/copy_spell): the spell was kicked. Schema 19: also on a spell on the stack (game_object in zone stack).

keys.description: attacking creature that has been blocked
keys.notes: Sticky per CR 509.1h; kept as a property on purpose.

On library_card: copies in the aggregate (schema 13: also the opponent's unseen hand cards, zone opp_hand). On history: number of objects in a batched event (draw, move_zone, discard, create) when > 1; always on reveal.

keys.description: cards above this one in the library
cards below this one in the library
fewest cards that can be above this one in the library
most cards that can be above this one in the library
pile this card was assigned to earlier in the scry/surveil being decided
keys.notes: "top", "bottom" or "graveyard"; only present while the arrangement is in progress (the cards have not moved yet).

keys.description: place already chosen for this card within its scry/surveil pile, counted from that pile's end of the library
keys.notes: 0 = top of library for the top pile, bottommost for the bottom pile; only while the arrangement is in progress.
No longer emitted since schema 19: a spell on the stack is its card's game_object (zone stack); every stack_item is an ability.
On an ability phantom (schema 13): the ability that left the stack was a trigger.

keys.description: position on the stack, counted from the top
keys.notes: Schema 19, spells (game_object in zone stack) and abilities (stack_item): 0 = top of the stack (resolves next). A spell still being cast (casting) counts as the top, every stack instance below it one deeper: the depth it will have once cast.

keys.description: this spell is being cast and is not on the stack yet
keys.notes: Schema 19: a card Forge has moved to the Stack zone during casting (modes, targets, costs, payment) before its stack instance exists. Also a card left in the Stack zone by a refused cast on Forge's AI path (failed_unrolled).
Schema 19, on a spell on the stack: a copy of a spell (not a card); it ceases to exist when it leaves the stack.

Card name of a stack item / delayed trigger. Redundant with their source_is edge. Not on history since schema 13 (role edge source_is); not on options since schema 16 (source_is edge). Schema 19: abilities only (a spell on the stack is its own card's game_object); absent, with source_oracle_id, when the source is face down and the viewer may not look at it.

keys.description: oracle id of the source card
which delayed trigger list: this turn only or until it triggers
keys.notes: Forge field name: delayedTriggers or thisTurnDelayedTriggers.

keys.description: casting attempt this event belongs to
keys.notes: Tag used to drop rolled-back attempts' events; an id, not a feature.

Schema 14, phantoms only: true for a token that left the battlefield or a copy/ability that left the stack; absent on an identity phantom (a card the viewer lost track of, which still exists somewhere it cannot tell: "a copy of X").

keys.description: tracking handles assigned to this token
keys.notes: Schema 13: the h<N> handles history edges point at that this token currently stands for (the object itself, the aggregate of the hidden zone it is in, the owner's untracked token, or a phantom). Each referenced handle is on exactly one token per state. Resolved by dump.resolve_edges; stripped by dump.strip_ids.

Schema 13; values magicnet.schema.HISTORY_VERBS. Replaces `event`. Schema 16, on an option token (type action): vocab action_verb (magicnet.schema.ACTION_VERBS), e.g. cast, pass, no_attack, scry_top. Schema 17: activate_mana, use_pool, pay_life (pay_mana), convoke, improvise (pay_convoke). Schema 18: optional_cost (choose_optional_cost, choose_additional_cost), choose_color (pay_mana_combo), waterbend (pay_convoke).

keys.description: which atomic game action this event was part of, counted from the start of the game
keys.notes: Schema 13: one step per resolution, cast/activation (with its costs), combat-damage batch, state-based-action check or turn-based action; events of one simultaneous batch share it. Counted per viewer over the events that viewer sees.

keys.description: order of this event within its step
keys.notes: Schema 13; 0-based.

Schema 13, on every history token: pointer (a consequence of the events its cause edges point at), turn_based, state_based (may also carry a cause edge to the lethal damage), combat, pregame, player_action or unknown.
Schema 13 move_zone: put, mill, exile, sacrifice, destroy, bounce, search, return or other.

keys.description: why the spell or ability did not resolve
keys.notes: Schema 13 does_not_resolve: countered (cause edge: the counterspell's resolve), fizzled (all targets illegal), removed (left the stack otherwise).

Schema 13 cast/copy_spell/trigger: chosen mode texts, in choice order. Schema 19, on a spell (game_object in zone stack, also while being cast) or an ability (stack_item) on the stack: the modes chosen for it.
Schema 13 cast/activate/copy_spell; omitted when zero.
Schema 13: life (life_change), counter count (counters_change), designation 0/1 or speed (designation_change).
Schema 13 counters_change: Forge counter name lowercased (+1/+1, loyalty, poison, lore ...), as in the ctr_<name> keys.
Schema 13 designation_change: monarch, initiative, city's blessing, speed, day, night.
Schema 13 special_action: turn_face_up, foretell, plot, unlock, or the Forge ability api lowercased (e.g. changezone for a companion).
Schema 13 mulligan.

keys.description: cards left on top of the library
keys.notes: Schema 13 scry/surveil.

keys.description: cards put on the bottom of the library
keys.notes: Schema 13 scry.

keys.description: cards put into the graveyard while surveilling
keys.notes: Schema 13 surveil.
attempt_end: committed, rolled_back, failed_unrolled or unknown.

keys.description: furthest step reached by the casting attempt
keys.notes: attempt_end: proposed, announce, targets or cost.

On history (activate, trigger): the ability's rules text (Forge description, object ids removed); unbounded vocabulary. On an ability phantom (schema 13): the text of the ability that left the stack. Schema 16, on an option token: the ability's normalized rules text (host's own name -> this creature/permanent/spell, no ids, bracketed context or player names; never empty) for cast/activate/play_land/confirm/mode/order_next. On the prompt: the asking ability's text when it has no token (its stack_object edge does not resolve). Schema 17: on an activate_mana option, the mana ability's text (riders such as Cavern of Souls' "can't be countered" are part of it). Schema 19, on a stack_item: the ability's rules text, normalized as on option tokens (the host's own name as "this creature/permanent/spell").
deal_damage: damage dealt.
deal_damage: combat damage.

Schema 13: history move/draw/discard/reveal: viewer-relative zone name from magicnet.schema.ZONES (e.g. opp_battlefield, stack). Omitted for a zone outside the vocabulary (created objects, Forge's None).
Schema 13: like `from`, the destination zone.
Schema 16 option token (cast/activate): legal targets (players and cards) of the ability, getAllCandidates(sa, false); absent when it does not target.

"ability" for priority, otherwise the routed callback (declare_attacker, ...); values magicnet.schema.DECISION_KINDS. Schema 16: also the prompt token's component. Schema 17: pay_mana, pay_convoke, pay_delve (-Dmagicnet.payment). Schema 18: pay_sacrifice, pay_discard, pay_exile, pay_tap, pay_untap, pay_return, pay_reveal, choose_optional_cost, choose_additional_cost, pay_mana_combo. Schema 20: announce (X and other announced values, -Dmagicnet.choices).
Schema 16: option token of a priority decision whose ability is a mana ability.

Schema 16: the pay option of a pay_unless decision, e.g. "{3}" or "2 life" (normalized; no leading "Pay"). Schema 17: the pay_life option of a pay_mana decision, "2 life". Schema 18: on an optional_cost option, the optional/keyword/additional cost (e.g. "{R}", "Sacrifice a creature with power 2 or greater"); on an activate_mana option, the mana ability's own mana cost (filters, Signets); on the prompt of a pay_sacrifice/pay_discard/pay_exile/pay_tap/pay_untap/pay_return/pay_reveal decision, the cost part being paid ("Sacrifice a creature", "Crew 1", "Emerge").

Schema 16: option token of a choose_number decision. Schema 20: of an announce decision (the announced X). Schema 18: on an optional_cost option of a multikicker/replicate/squad decision, how many times the cost is paid.
Schema 20: prompt of an announce decision (announceRequirements): the announced variable, "X" for an X cost.

keys.description: what the game asks the player
keys.notes: Schema 16: Forge's prompt/title for the decision (object ids, bracketed context and player names removed); omitted when Forge gives none.
Schema 16: minimum targets (choose_target), modes (choose_mode) or number (choose_number). Schema 20: smallest value an announce decision allows.
Schema 16: maximum targets, modes or number. Schema 20: on an announce decision, the largest value offered (the engine bound capped at the largest affordable X).
Schema 16: a choose_nothing option is offered. Schema 17: on pay_convoke / pay_delve, stopping (choose_nothing) is offered because the rest is payable from mana sources.

keys.description: how many have already been chosen in this decision
keys.notes: Schema 16: earlier steps of the same decomposed decision (attackers/blockers declared so far, targets already chosen, cards already placed, triggers already ordered); those with a token are also selected edges. Schema 17: pay_mana -- sources already tapped for this cost; pay_convoke / pay_delve -- cards already chosen.

Schema 16: a decision candidate {"ref": id-or-handle} that IS an existing token (target, defender, attacker to block, library-search pick via its n:<name> aggregate). Resolved by dump.resolve_candidates; never embedded.
Schema 17 (pay_mana, pay_convoke, pay_delve): the unpaid part of the cost being paid, Forge's mana symbols, e.g. "{1}{U}", "{1}{B/P}{B/P}", "{G/W}".
Schema 17: unpaid generic mana of the cost being paid; absent when 0.
Schema 18 (pay_tap for crew-style costs, "tap creatures with total power N"): power still needed beyond the creatures already chosen; absent when 0.
Schema 17: unpaid shards of the cost being paid that white mana can pay (a hybrid shard counts under each of its colours, a Phyrexian shard under its colour); absent when 0.
Schema 17: unpaid shards of the cost being paid that blue mana can pay (a hybrid shard counts under each of its colours, a Phyrexian shard under its colour); absent when 0.
Schema 17: unpaid shards of the cost being paid that black mana can pay (a hybrid shard counts under each of its colours, a Phyrexian shard under its colour); absent when 0.
Schema 17: unpaid shards of the cost being paid that red mana can pay (a hybrid shard counts under each of its colours, a Phyrexian shard under its colour); absent when 0.
Schema 17: unpaid shards of the cost being paid that green mana can pay (a hybrid shard counts under each of its colours, a Phyrexian shard under its colour); absent when 0.
Schema 17: unpaid shards of the cost being paid that colorless mana can pay (a hybrid shard counts under each of its colours, a Phyrexian shard under its colour); absent when 0.

keys.notes: Schema 17 (pay_mana): mana already paid into this cost, by colour; absent when 0.

keys.description: blue mana already spent on this cost
keys.notes: Schema 17 (pay_mana): mana already paid into this cost, by colour; absent when 0.

keys.notes: Schema 17 (pay_mana): mana already paid into this cost, by colour; absent when 0.

keys.notes: Schema 17 (pay_mana): mana already paid into this cost, by colour; absent when 0.

keys.description: green mana already spent on this cost
keys.notes: Schema 17 (pay_mana): mana already paid into this cost, by colour; absent when 0.

keys.description: colorless mana already spent on this cost
keys.notes: Schema 17 (pay_mana): mana already paid into this cost, by colour; absent when 0.

keys.description: snow mana already spent on this cost
keys.notes: Schema 17 (pay_mana): how much of the mana already paid into this cost was snow; absent when 0.

keys.description: life already paid for Phyrexian mana in this cost
keys.notes: Schema 17 (pay_mana): life committed to Phyrexian shards so far (taken when the cost is fully paid); absent when 0.

Schema 17: the colour an activate_mana option tells the ability to make, or a use_pool option spends; values magicnet.schema.MANA_COLORS (C = colourless). Schema 18: the colour a choose_color option (pay_mana_combo) adds.
Schema 17: mana one activation adds (activate_mana), or units of identical mana floating (use_pool).

keys.description: mana that may only be spent on some spells
keys.notes: Schema 17: use_pool option of restricted pool mana (it can pay this spell, or it would not be offered).
Schema 17: use_pool option of snow mana.

keys.description: what spending this mana does besides paying
keys.notes: Schema 17: use_pool option of pool mana whose spending changes the spell or triggers (Cavern of Souls: can't be countered; mana that grants counters or keywords): the normalized text of the ability that made it. Each such unit is its own option.
Schema 17 (pay_convoke): the shard a convoke/improvise option pays, e.g. "{G}" or "{1}".

patterns.notes: Expanded concretely from counter_keys.json; an unseen counter still gets "<name> counters".
AttemptEnd: values announced while casting (X, multikicker count, ...).

role_java_exprs_about: Dynamic key expressions allowed without a pattern. Schema 13: m.getKey() is GameHistory.append copying a history record's modifier map onto the token; those keys are scanned where HistoryHub writes them (r.mods.put). History participants are edges (magicnet.schema.RELATIONS), not role-named keys.
record_fields_about: Serializer's decision-record envelope. Not token components, except kind/turn/phase which are registered keys (turn and phase duplicate the global token). hidden_truth (schema 15, dump only, -Dmagicnet.labels=true) is a training-only TARGET, never a model input; its entries use label_fields.
label_fields_about: Fields of a hidden_truth label: {region: id of the hidden-region state token it labels, cards: [{oracle_id, name, count}], total}. Belief-model targets only; never embedded as inputs.
